Meet the Team 
Meet the inspirational leaders who are passionate about our software and delivering results for our customers 
Chief Executive Officer 
 Gustavo Gómez 
Gustavo is an entrepreneur who loves solving problems. Equipped with a degree in Computer Science, Gustavo pursued a career in software engineering in Europe and Colombia. In 1989 he founded Bizagi, short for business agility. Despite running a global business, Gustavo's passion for delighting customers hasn't changed. Those around him admire his accessibility and hands-on approach, demonstrated through his daily customer interactions, involvement with product improvements, and strategic thinking. Gustavo remains the embodiment of Bizagi's values of integrity, honesty, and commitment to exceptional service.
Chief Financial Officer 
 Chris Sullivan 
Chris is a passionate and results-oriented finance executive with over 30 years of diverse finance experience helping high-tech companies grow and scale their global teams and operations. Prior to joining Bizagi, Chris was CFO of Imprivata, a digital identity security software company where he focused on optimizing the finance team and business operations for their next phase of profitable growth. His other work experience includes several CFO roles guiding software/technology businesses through periods of growth and transformation including 5 years as CFO at Pegasystems.
Chief Technology Officer 
 Jesus Sanchez 
Jesus Sanchez manages product development and engineering execution for the Bizagi platform. Innovative, challenging, and willing to be challenged, Jesus is a rare breed of CTOs with a passion for software usability and a quest to deliver solutions that enable both business and technical users to get results fast. With over 20 years’ leadership experience of managing the entire lifecycle of software development, Jesus has a wealth of knowledge to deliver the company’s ambitious technology vision.A Javeriana University graduate with a degree in Electronics Engineering, Jesus is an active OMG member, responsible for defining BPMN and CMMN standards.
VP, Solutions Consulting 
 Marcel Manser 
As a Bizagi co-founder, Marcel has vast product and company knowledge. Marcel is a seasoned executive with over 30 years of experience in the technology industry. As Vice President of Solutions Consulting, Marcel leads a team of experts who work closely with clients to identify their unique business challenges and develop customized solutions that drive results. Marcel’s prior experience includes working for IBM and Credit Suisse in Switzerland. He holds degrees in Finance and Computer Science from Universidad De Los Andes, Colombia.
VP of Human Resources 
Laura Whittingham- Jones 
Business-focused HR leader bringing over 20 years of HR experience to Bizagi. Specialising in the tech-sector, her previous roles include regional and global HR leadership at TIBCO software, along with a range of interim positions and HR strategy consultancy. Laura is passionate about creating the right environment for employees to achieve the organization’s goals by delivering the change management, organizational design and HR systems needed to maximize the potential of an organization’s workforce.
VP of Customer Service 
 Eva Pereiro 
Eva has nearly twenty years of experience as a consultant for financial institutions across the globe. Throughout her career in PWC, Arthur Andersen and in her time at Bizagi, she has led a wide range of strategic transformation projects including organizational change, internal control systems and process redesign, as well as strategic and operational efficiency.
VP of Product Marketing 
 Rachel Brennan 
Rachel is an innovative marketing leader with 20 years’ experience in process automation. Rachel moved from implementor, to sales, to evangelist, and finally to product marketing where she brings that practical experience to her thought leadership. Rachel is passionate about bringing process thinking and automation to the world in a fun and quirky manner. Rachel has previously held Product Marketing Director positions at OutSystems and TIBCO where her responsibilities included: Messaging, Thought Leadership, Go To Market Planning, Sales Enablement, and Analyst Relations. 
VP, EMEA 
 Jurgen Neubauer 
Jürgen Neubauer is an experienced IT Executive with more than 20 years of management experience in international companies as Chief Revenue Officer, Executive Vice President Sales and Managing Director. Jurgen has a proven track record for enterprise business software and SaaS Solutions with experience of taking companies through start up, fund raising, IPO and M&A. His experience spans organizations including IBM, Chordiant Software, Pegasystems, Smart Focus.
VP, Latin America 
 Juan Pablo Rincón 
Strategic executive with over 20 years of experience in Latin America, driving innovation in customer experience, cloud solutions, and AI-powered automation to accelerate digital transformation and help organizations thrive in evolving markets. Prior to joining Bizagi, Juan Pablo held leadership positions at AWS, Huawei, Cisco, and Avaya, leading transformational initiatives across banking, government, education, healthcare, and other industries. His ability to harness innovation and disruptive technologies helps businesses optimize operations and unlock new opportunities for growth in the digital era.
Sales Director, North America 
 Jordan Mackey 
Jordan is a seasoned technology and customer-focused executive with a strong track record of driving sustainable business value through strategic technology investments. Driven by new challenges, Jordan currently supports Bizagi in enabling organizations to adapt and transform in response to rapidly evolving customer expectations and market dynamics.
Jordan brings extensive experience across manufacturing, finance, and the power industry, gained through working in and selling to these markets.
Board Members 
Chairman 
Peter Williamson 
Peter is Professor of International Management at the University of Cambridge, Judge Business School and Fellow of Jesus College. He is Chairman of Bizagi Group and has served as a non-executive director of companies spanning whisky through to green energy. Formerly with Merrill Lynch and The Boston  Consulting Group, he earned his PhD in Business Economics from Harvard  University. His research covers globalisation, strategy, M&A and ecosystem innovation. He is the author of ten books. The latest, Ecosystem Edge (2020) explains how companies can build and leverage a network of partnerships that sustain competitiveness in the face of disruption.
Benedetto “Ben” Staccia 
Ben is a Managing Director at Invus, based in Paris. He serves on the board of several technology and consumer companies. Prior to joining Invus in 2008, Ben was a management consultant with McKinsey & Company, where he worked with clients in a wide range of industries including telecommunications, energy, technology, and financial services. Ben received an MBA from Harvard Business School and also holds an MS in Engineering from Politecnico di Milano and from Ecole Centrale de Paris.
Mario Kaloustian 
Mario is a Managing Director at Invus (www.invus.com), based in Paris. He is on the board of several European technology and software companies. Prior to joining Invus in 2008, Mario had ten years of management consulting and operational experience, including in software development. He has an engineering degree from Telecom ParisTech and an MBA from INSEAD. He joined Bizagi’s board in 2019.
